engines.reason: Seeded synthetic motion over a district. It reads no authorised input, so an edit never reaches it and nothing but its own seed decides where anybody goes; the worker does not play it, and it holds the 100 to 512 people a district was sized for.

Purposeful goals, routes and the two reviewed activities over authorised inputs, with typed user-directed actions, and the person whose world it lives in can send its people away and bring them back. A person whose world's owner chose a model for them takes, at the planner's own choice point, that model's validated choice from a stored receipt, replayed without a call; with no choice nothing changes. A comparison runs the same hour of it with each of several deciders from the same genesis, beside the society and never changing it. It stands on a district or on a saved world's own ground, where it starts with a handful of people, so its floor is one; a district's floor of 100 is the initializer's.

The purposeful society plus a bounded cast with local observations, communicated beliefs and explicitly requested, validated model proposals. Its state carries every purposeful field and a social block. Its people are not sent away: its cast would leave and return with memories this version does not model.

The living society: catalogued routines, occupancy and a population sized to its place. Its place contract reads streets, occupancy and stated surface heights, which a saved world's flat ground does not state, so it stands on a district only; it takes no directed actions or model decisions.
